newsitem.title: USA: CSCE March world sugar ends slightly higher.
newsitem.headline: CSCE March world sugar ends slightly higher.

text.p: CSCE March world sugar futures settled slightly firmer but below resistance seen at 10.70 cents basis the March contract.
Traders noted buying by Far Eastern trade houses in the March/May spread, and commission house and local buying which carried the spot-March contract to the day's high of 10.70 cents.
A lack of followthrough and steady producer pricing knocked prices off the highs. Dealers said speculative buying could emerge over 10.70 in May, the recent high made Tuesday.
While March remains the most active contract with open interest at 50,019 lots on Tuesday's close, new positions should be put in May, a broker said.
Open interest in second-position May rose 555 lots to 39,159 lots as of Tuesday's close.
The March contract closed 0.03 cent higher to 10.66 cents, having ranged from 10.71 to 10.56 cents. The deferred contracts settled 0.03 to 0.05 cent lower.
Volume was estimated at 23,690 lots compared with Tuesday's official volume of 24,389 lots.
Support was seen at 10.59 cents in March.
